answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, where each agent acts as a vertex in a reputation graph. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a ridge of prohibitive capital requirements, as the cost to acquire enough tokens for network influence scales linearly with systemic risk. Much like the dense cellular structure of timber, the network relies on the verifiable density of staked assets to insulate itself against the proliferation of low-cost, malicious ephemeral agents.
